confirmed_facts: GET /health returns status ok; POST /api/fare-estimates accepts numeric positive decimal distanceKm and returns distanceKm/amount/UAH. Strict JSON numbers and disallowed unmapped members reject client tariff/amount/currency overrides.

FareCalculator.cs uses decimal operands and checked BaseFare + distanceKm * RatePerKm, then exactly one decimal.Round(amount,2,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero). Unit tests independently cover 1.005=>1.01 and 0.004+0.004=>0.01, preventing component rounding.

FareTariffOptions uses nullable decimal mandatory values. Program.cs validates both >=0 with ValidateOnStart; FareTariff constructor also rejects negatives. Binding malformed numeric config fails startup. Immutable tariff and singleton calculator hold server tariff.

Controller rejects null/missing/nonpositive input; MVC stable factory rejects malformed/out-of-range JSON; overflow is caught as 400 ValidationProblemDetails without exception details. Both multiplication and addition overflow are covered by calculator tests; HTTP source covers both paths.

Tests isolate each host from ambient tariff by clearing configuration sources and adding synthetic 40/12. Test source covers request override rejection, safe error body, midpoint, final sum, config startup and arithmetic overflow.

README and current Backend-API note explicitly identify client distance as untrusted demo input: no quoteId/expiry/server route/tariff snapshot/order confirmation. FR-03 remains incomplete, not a newly discovered defect.
